questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 8 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 16 × 8 = 64 cm². Halving is the step that's easy to rush past.

questions.why: A cylinder has two flat circular ends, so total surface area equals the curved area plus both circles, not just one.

questions.prompt: In Lord of the Flies, what does the conch shell mostly stand for?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In an open dish, why does the measured mass appear to decrease after burning wood?
questions.why: Mass isn't actually lost overall — gas produced by burning escapes into the air, so the container appears lighter when weighed.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a reaction releases heat and things feel warmer?
questions.why: An exothermic reaction releases heat energy to its surroundings, making the container or mixture feel warmer.

questions.subject: PDHPE

questions.subject: PDHPE
